external.note: The owner's Blendify MCP server (tools generate_3d, wait_for_3d_job, import_canonical_model) posting to his n8n workflow '3D Model Generator', which calls fal TRELLIS-2 (and OpenRouter in text mode). Paid per job. Image mode needs the workflow's 'Has Input Image?' branch and a server restarted on the image-mode code. Webhook base and key live only in the MCP server's environment: never in a tracked file, the repo is public.

Background Blender (blender -b --factory-startup) runs preview_glb.py, render_ortho.py and mesh_stats.py and builds the test figure; found through the companion skill's blender_env.py (--blender-exe, --local-config tools.blender.path, BLENDER, PATH, standard folder). Tested on Blender 5.1.2. No live session is used.
Host Python 3.9+ launches the Blender tools and runs grid.py and pose_angles.py.
Host numpy for pose_angles.py; inside Blender the tools use Blender's bundled numpy.
grid.py always; pose_angles.py only for --centre-limbs, --overlay-dir and a hip_rule without ground_y.
Runs tests/; the Blender suite skips when no Blender is found, the host suites run anywhere.
